work: PRED-0011: Cryo-EM 3D potentiation-vs-folding pocket proximity benchmark testing whether E(3)-invariant intra-8EIQ pocket geometry predicts US FDA KALYDECO v36 Table 3 ivacaftor monotherapy responsiveness on the fixed 20-variant domain-disjoint held-out test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal).

claims.statement: In PDB 8EIQ Model 1 Chain A (tools/cftr-model/data/8EIQ.cif.gz, CC0 1.0, 1,162 placed C-alpha residues with codon 508 absent), the disjoint heavy-atom anchor sets contain 93 potentiation atoms (ATP=62, MG=2, VX7=29) and 103 folding/corrector atoms (CV6=37, WJX=41, W1063=14, R1070=11), reproducing 8 of 8 published non-benchmark Cryo-EM pocket contacts (Y304, S307, F311, F931 < 8.0 A from VX7; K464, K1250 < 4.0 A from ATP; W361 < 5.0 A from CV6; R1102 < 6.0 A from WJX) with exact SE(3) rigid-motion invariance (< 1e-12).
claims.dataset: tools/cftr-model/data/8EIQ.cif.gz (RCSB PDB 8EIQ, CC0 1.0) + tools/cftr-model/data/p13569.json (UniProtKB P13569, CC BY 4.0)

methods.name: shlex mmCIF loop parser with 8.0 A 3D spatial voxel grid
methods.difference: tokenizes _atom_site via shlex, verifies P13569 residue alignment, and indexes heavy atoms in an 8.0 A cubic voxel grid

methods.name: state-machine mmCIF tokenizer with 50-digit Decimal norms
methods.difference: zero shared imports; parses mmCIF character-by-character without shlex/re and counts heavy atoms in exact Decimal coordinates

claims.statement: On the 11 placed missense variants of the fixed 20-variant held-out test split (NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal; 5 KALYDECO-responsive and 6 non-responsive), E(3)-invariant intra-8EIQ pocket proximity s_3D(i) = d_fold(i) / (d_pot(i) + d_fold(i)) achieves conditional ROC-AUC 0.933333 (14/15 = 28/30 pairs), exceeding standalone AlphaMissense responsiveness s_AM(i) = 1 - AM(i) at 0.666667 (2/3 = 20/30 pairs) and the constant-missense sequence-consequence baseline at 0.500000.
claims.dataset: tools/cftr-model/data/8EIQ.cif.gz + benchmarks/theratype/theratype_open_annotations_2026-11-21.json (openfda-label KALYDECO v36 Table 3 + myvariant dbnsfp.alphamissense)

methods.name: voxel-grid float64 Euclidean distance + pairwise Mann-Whitney loop
methods.difference: evaluates min distances via VoxelGrid3D + math.dist and enumerates all 30 positive-negative missense pairs in float64

methods.name: 50-digit Decimal brute-force distance + exact Fraction Wilcoxon rank-sum
methods.difference: computes (dx^2+dy^2+dz^2).sqrt() in 50-digit Decimal and exact Wilcoxon rank-sum U/(|S_1||S_0|) = 14/15 in fractions.Fraction

claims.statement: Across all 20 held-out test variants (7 KALYDECO-responsive and 13 non-responsive across NBD1, TMD2, NBD2_C_terminal), class-gated 3D pocket proximity g_3D achieves abstention-aware ROC-AUC 0.824176 (75/91 pairs, held-out error 1 - AUC = 0.175824), exceeding both the deterministic sequence-consequence class baseline at 0.681319 (62/91 pairs) and identically gated g_AM at 0.736264 (67/91 pairs), supporting pre-registered PRED-0011.

methods.name: regex canonical-splice gate + float64 pairwise Mann-Whitney ROC-AUC
methods.difference: applies CANONICAL_SPLICE_RE + 0.50 + 0.50*s_3D and enumerates all 91 positive-negative pairs directly

methods.name: charwise HGVS splice gate + exact Fraction Wilcoxon mid-rank sum
methods.difference: parses canonical +/-1,2 splice sites character-by-character without regex and evaluates exact rational rank-sum 75/91

claims.statement: On the 10-variant Lasso_N_terminal / TMD1 / R_domain train split (7 missense: 4 KALYDECO-responsive P67L, R117H, G178R, L206W and 3 non-responsive G85E, R334W, R347P), static s_3D yields conditional missense ROC-AUC 0.250000 (3/12 pairs) because mild residual-trafficking/conductance alleles P67L, R117H, and L206W sit closer to transmembrane corrector pockets than to ATP/VX7 while non-responsive TM6 salt-bridge proline mutant R347P sits 12.0840 A from VX7.

Fiedorczuk and Chen (2022) determined the 3.0 A Cryo-EM structure of phosphorylated human deltaF508-CFTR bound simultaneously to elexacaftor (VX-445), tezacaftor (VX-661), ivacaftor (VX-770), and ATP/Mg2+ (PDB 8EIQ), resolving distinct transmembrane corrector binding cavities in TMD1 and TMD2/Lasso alongside the TM8 ivacaftor potentiator cleft and NBD1:NBD2 ATP dimer.

Liu et al. (2019) identified the ivacaftor (VX-770) potentiator binding site at the unwound transmembrane helix TM8 hinge of phosphorylated ATP-bound human CFTR within the lipid bilayer interface, contacting residues including Y304, S307, F311, and F931.
claims.attributed_to: Liu, Zhang, Levit, Chen et al. (2019), Science 364(6446):1184-1188
